verdicts.note: Two independent, explicit statements: a philosophy 'of restraint' applying statutes as written 'rather than legislating from the bench' (S3), and 'constitutional originalist ... the law as written — without activism' (S2). That is the pole_a language almost verbatim, so -2 at high holds. His remark about access to courts (S2) is not an interpretive position.

Sitting judge, by appointment since November 2025 (S3), with Ferry County pro tem service from 2023 and prosecutor and defense practice (S3, S4). The incumbent profile, offset by short tenure and an opponent with the longer bench record, supports -1 at medium.

Attacked on two points. First, the length of his record is uncertain: his statement claims District Court 2015-2022, but reporting puts it at four years before resigning in 2021, then Superior Court 2022-2025 (S1, S2), so it is about seven years, not ten. Second, he left the bench in 2025 to be mayor (S2, S4). Even so, he was twice elected to the Superior Court (S6), has presided over about 70 jury trials (S1), and runs on that record. He has the longest record in the race. -2 holds, and medium confidence already reflects the discrepancy about his tenure.
